title: Preserve 5rvk decompress-side coverage when 7v5f (779600c0c3) merges: re-home deadbeef-RX-reject + valid-fallback round-trip assertions
description: Found by correctness review pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-5rvk (P3, merge hazard). 5rvk added decompress-side coverage to lichen/tests/schc/main.c test_uncompressed_fallback: (a) non-IPv6 rule255 payload (deadbeef) is REJECTED at decompress (RX validation via the profile validate_payload hook), and (b) a valid no-rule-match IPv6 UDP packet round-trips byte-preserving through the fallback. 7v5f's commit 779600c0c3 (compress rejects non-IPv6 input) renames that test to test_reject_non_ipv6_input and flips its RUN_TEST line - a naive 'take theirs' merge resolution would silently DELETE 5rvk's decompress-side assertions. On the merged tree compress no longer emits deadbeef-as-rule255, so the reject assertion must be re-homed to a hand-built ff|deadbeef frame. Fix at merge time: keep 7v5f's compress-side test, re-add (a) as a decompress test with a hand-built ff frame and (b) as the valid fallback round-trip, in whatever test function fits the merged file. Tracking bead only - no code change until the merge.
